OUT-OF-SANDBOX.reason: The change addresses something outside the connected course, which this harness never touches.

NO-FIXTURE.reason: The sandbox course holds no object of this kind to address the route with.

QUEUE-COLLISION.reason: Another request for the same target was still waiting, so this one was not settled.

PERSON-SETTINGS.reason: The change alters the signed-in person's own account settings rather than course content.

OUTBOUND.reason: The change leaves Canvas for someone: a ticket, a message, or another course.

PROVIDER-REFUSED.reason: Canvas refused the request for this connection, so no expected state can be read back.

NO-READBACK.reason: Canvas has no read that shows the saved result of this change.

NEEDS-LEARNER-ATTEMPT.reason: The object exists only after a learner attempt, and the sandbox course has none.

IRREVERSIBLE.reason: The change cannot be undone on a person or a whole course, so it is never attempted here.

NO-TENANT.reason: No Moodle test tenant is connected to this machine.

NEEDS-FIXTURE.reason: Needs an assignment whose description carries an image with no description.

BLOCKED-OTHER.reason: This run has no quiz to order.
